result.description:
About the Role
We are looking for an Experienced Gardener to join our professional team based from our Landsdale yard, working across a variety of commercial and residential sites throughout the Perth metropolitan area.

If you take pride in creating and maintaining attractive outdoor spaces and enjoy working with a great team, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
Lawn mowing, edging and garden maintenance
Pruning trees, shrubs and hedges
Weed identification and control
Planting, mulching and general garden improvements
Operate gardening equipment safely and efficiently
Travel from the Landsdale yard to various metro work sites
Maintain a high standard of workmanship

Skills & Experience
To be successful you will have:
Previous gardening or grounds maintenance experience
Current WA Driver's Licence (essential)
Spray Operator's Ticket highly regarded but not essential
Strong work ethic and positive attitude
Ability to work independently and within a team
Reliable, punctual and physically fit
What's on Offer
Top industry rates
Full-time hours
Great team environment
Long-term career opportunity
Ongoing support and training
Variety of work across Perth metropolitan areas

Applicants must be living in Australia with easy access to Landsdale, Perth WA.

Employer Questions
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
Do you have previous gardening or grounds maintenance experience?
Do you hold a current WA Driver's Licence?
Do you hold a Spray Operator's Certificate or Chemical Handling Ticket? (Preferred but not essential)
Are you currently living in Australia with easy access to Landsdale, Perth WA?
